notes.title: eSports WRC: The new season starts now in WRC 7!
notes.notes:
eSports WRC is back for a third season!

This competition is open to all players of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/621830/WRC_7_FIA_World_Rally_Championship/] WRC 7[/url], the official game of the FIA World Rally Championship (WRC). 
During this first round, players will face the legendary Rallye Monte-Carlo at the same time that the real pilots.

https://youtu.be/DruZOjxnyi0

This year, a brand new team championship has been created! Starting from Rally Sweden on February 15th, the best drivers will score points for their crew and try to win the first eSports WRC team championship title.

Who will challenge Nexl, the undisputed champion of 2017? It could be you! So get ready to face the challenging icy stages of the iconic Monte Carlo Rally on January 25th.

Details and information on http://www.esportswrc.com/
For any questions regarding the team championship: teams@esportswrc.com

notes.title: Patch 1.0.51
notes.notes:
We've just releaded patch 1.0.51 which fixes some bugs introduced in patch 1.0.5 :

- Fix Thrustmaster TMX configuration
- Fix Fanatec Handbrake
- Added support for Fanatec CSL Elite Wheel base
- Added support for Fanatec CSL Pedals USB
- Bug fix in USB device detection
- Input bindings are now shown as "Steering Wheel Button" instead of "Button"
- Fix steering wheel input bindings breaking menu navigation
- Steering wheel is now set as the default controller when axis detection configuration is saved

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Heads up, drivers!
We’ve just released a new patch (as detailed below), including various fixes, additions, and a brand new reward system for weekly events. 
Thank you all for your patience and for helping us correcting these issues.

[b](Last update) Version 1.0.5:[/b]
[list]
[*]Add Physics simulation setting. Low simulation decreases cpu cost but might add stuttering with vsync.
[*]Add Brazilian Portuguese localisation
[*]Add Japanese localisation
[*]Add Simplified Chinese localisation
[*]Add Korean localisation
[*]Add weekly event rewards on driver card
[*]Fixed steering wheel inputs binding for non-supported wheels
[*]Fixed Fanatec handbrake plugged on Fanatac pedals V3
[*]Fix 2nd external camera not being properly saved/restored
[*]Fix Neste Rally Finland logo
[*]Online replay bug fix after cancelling downloaded data message box
[*]Added setup tips on car parameters
[*]Other players markers on progress bar visibility bug fix
[*]Fix skidmarks during replays
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.41
notes.notes:
Hello drivers!

The team worked hard to bring you this new patch, please read the changelog below and give us your feedbacks!

- [b]Switch co-driver language option added[/b] in Gameplay/Co-driver menu: if option is changed while ingame, copilot will finish the current pacenotes in previous language before switching.

- [b]Reduced stuttering[/b] when VSync is enabled (50Hz, 60Hz), you need to restart the race if this setting is changed during a race.

- Advanced setup when playing against a leaderboard crash fix
- Portugal SSS Lousada respawn bug fix
- Spain SSS Barcelona respawn bug fix

- [b]G920 X and B Button fixed[/b]
- Steering wheel angle restored when leaving game
- Wheel angle setting is not displayed anymore when not supported

Thank you all for your patience and for helping us correcting all these issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.31
notes.notes:
- DirectX error at launch fixed
- Lobby not transitioning to race bug fix
- Lobby creation when choosing "SSS Only" option bug fix
- Logitech G920 Force Feedback effects not being stopped when game is paused or race is finished bug fix
- More checks added to avoid posting wrong/cheated scores on leaderboards

Concerning the G920, we are aware of the two buttons being inverted in the menus, it will be corrected in the next patch.

For players having issues with the G29 on Windows 7 and Windows 10, please ensure the Logitech "Gaming Software" is launched on your computer.
